latest_cos_commentary.headline: Otter is a multichannel order-aggregation and POS platform (founded 2020) with published tiered pricing ($79-$278/month) and named restaurant relationships spanning independents through recognizable multi-unit brands (Wingstop, Jack in the Box, Denny's).
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Direct competitor to Genius across pos and online-ordering/aggregation, with published pricing that undercuts typical enterprise POS deals for smaller locations; its order-aggregation-first origin gives it a distinct wedge into accounts already using multiple delivery channels.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Named large-brand relationships (Wingstop, Jack in the Box, Denny's) suggest Otter has moved beyond independents into recognizable multi-unit accounts, though the exact scope (pilot vs. full deployment) of each named relationship is unconfirmed.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where Otter is mentioned, ask specifically whether the prospect uses it for order aggregation only or as their primary POS — Otter's pricing and packaging differ significantly between those two use cases.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: The scope of Otter's named enterprise-brand relationships (pilot, single-market, or full chain-wide deployment) was not independently confirmed beyond vendor marketing-site logos; treat as directional evidence of market reach, not proof of full deployment.

verification_needed: verified scope of named enterprise customer deployments
